- 104 - • To drill the 17 1/2 section to 1850 in, use KC1-polymer-Low pH fluid. Severe Gumbo formations are anticipated and this system should efficiently inhibit the formation and cuttings, and transport the cuttings to the surface for mechanical removal from the fluid. The KCl-Polymer, low pH system is made up of the f

romicaceous and non to very calcareous. Scattered nodules of calcite are common. The claystones show the same colour variations as the siltstones. They are hard to soft, micromicaceous and slightly to very calcareous, and contain swelling clay minerals (smectites). The marls are buff white to grey and soft. The limestones are white to grey and hard.
